rubric.criterion: Historical v1 and v2 fixtures migrate one step at a time to the validated current v3 document.
One pure JSON-object-in, JSON-object-out function hides registry traversal and validation.
Every envelope has an integer schema_version and every migration advances exactly one version.
The input is not mutated; missing, malformed, unsupported, and future versions fail clearly.
Envelope migration is forward-only and performs no database access or implicit write-back.
Registry, schemas, and append-only version steps live under migrations/envelopes.
